package.description: A powerful tool for modelling in science, mathematics, technology and computing.

en-US.description: A powerful tool for modelling in science, mathematics, technology and computing.
en-US.longDescription: Yenka is a powerful tool for modelling in science, mathematics, technology and computing. It lets you experiment safely and easily in a virtual world. Its entirely new user interface is designed to be easier to use in the classroom, especially with interactive whiteboards.
en-US.name: Yenka (German)

zh-CN.description: 强大的科学、数学、技术与计算建模工具
zh-CN.longDescription: Yenka 是一款功能强大的科学、数学、技术与计算建模工具。它让您能在虚拟世界中安全便捷地进行实验。其全新设计的用户界面特别适合课堂教学场景，尤其适配交互式电子白板的使用。
